SiteConfig.title: SiteConfig
SiteConfig.description: Published brutalist architectural firm website content including copy, metrics, projects, architects, and optional hosted walkthrough video URL.

payload.description: JSON-serialized site copy, metrics, 6 projects, and 6 architect profiles.

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last admin publish.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who published the site configuration.

SiteMedia.title: SiteMedia
SiteMedia.description: Compressed web-optimized image asset (firm logo, background photo, architect headshot, or project shot) stored for public viewing.

dataUrl.description: Web-optimized base64 data URL of the image.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who uploaded the image.

/siteConfig/{configId}.description: Publicly readable, admin-writable website content configuration.

/siteMedia/{mediaId}.description: Publicly readable, admin-writable compressed image assets.
